About

About Retro Forever

Retro Forever is a New York fashion jewelry house founded by the head designer and CEO of Frenzy Jewels, whose work has supplied specialty boutiques and the American wholesale market for nearly two decades. The line pairs on-trend design with the materials buyers expect at retail — gold- and rhodium-plated brass, freshwater pearls, natural stones, glass, and crystal — across necklaces, bracelets, and earrings.

It is built for wholesale. More than 200 open-price styles are held in stock at our U.S. warehouse, sold by the dozen and priced to move at retail, so buyers can open with a small assortment and reorder best sellers without long lead times. From single boutiques to national chains and distributors, orders ship fast from inventory on hand.

Wholesale

Wholesale Terms

Simple, buyer-friendly terms designed for fast turns and easy reorders.

Pricing
Open price. Styles run roughly $3–$12 per piece, sold by the dozen.
Suggested retail
Keystone-plus — a 3.2–3.5× markup over wholesale.
Quantities
Sold by the dozen. First orders may include a limited number of ½-dozen styles — same price per piece either way.
Minimum order
$100 on a first order.
Payment
Credit card, ACH, check or wire transfer. Credit cards add 3%; wires add $20.
Availability
In-stock. 200+ styles held at our U.S. warehouse.
Reorders
Fast — shipped from inventory on hand, no long lead times.
Shipping
FOB our U.S. warehouse via UPS / FedEx; prepaid & add or on your carrier account.
